task.title: Rewrite templates/agents/architect.md for markdown specs + SQLite-backed intent capture
task.description:
The architect template still cites the file-based GOALS → DISCUSSION → BLUEPRINT workflow and "task XML" everywhere. Rewrite for the new flow.
Replace **Mode Selection**:
Old: ``` 1. `docs/trustmybot/GOALS.md` has unclosed goals → Workflow Mode ``` New: ``` 1. MCP `issue_resume` returns an open issue with pending tasks → Workflow Mode 2. Human says "direct mode" / "just do it" / "skip workflow" → Direct Mode 3. Multi-file changes or architectural decisions → Workflow Mode 4. Everything else → Direct Mode ```
Replace the **Workflow Mode** body: ``` Follow: issue (MCP) → discussion (MCP) → tasks (markdown specs + MCP) → SWE → validate. See `.claude/skills/architect-workflow.md`. ```
Replace **Source Code Prohibition** clause about the task XML:
Old: ``` Task files MUST have `status="open"` and `` set or the hook blocks SWE spawn. ``` New: ``` Markdown task specs MUST have YAML frontmatter `authorized_by:` and `status: pending|open` or `require-task-spec.sh` blocks the SWE spawn. The matching `tasks` row in SQLite (created via `task_create_batch`) holds the canonical state; the file is the SWE-readable handoff. ```
Add a new section **Intent Capture (replaces GOALS / DISCUSSION / BLUEPRINT files)**:
``` The Human's intent and the architect-Human alignment dialogue live in MCP, not in markdown files.
| Old artifact | New mechanism | |----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------| | GOALS.md | issue_create(objective=..., goals_md=...) once per ask | | DISCUSSION.md Q+A | discussion_append(kind='question'|'answer', ...) | | BLUEPRINT.md (simple)| discussion_append(kind='decision', body_md=plan) | | BLUEPRINT.md (diff.) | docs/trustmybot/architecture/manual/decisions/N-...md |
For human review handoff, generate a snapshot: issue_snapshot_md(issue_id) → docs/trustmybot/snapshots/.md
The snapshot is read-only; never edit it. To revise, append a new discussion_append and regenerate. ```
Replace **Spec Authoring** (this section may not exist yet — add it):
``` For each task in a planned batch: 1. Compute the branch_id (git-convention; gatekeeper proposes). 2. Compute the spec filename: docs/trustmybot/tasks/<branch_id with / replaced by ->.md 3. Author the spec following docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md: frontmatter (issue_id, branch_id, title, status: pending, authorized_by: architect, authorized_at, depends_on) + body sections (Description, Files, Success Criteria, Verification, Out of Scope, Commit, Results: empty). 4. Call MCP task_create_batch(...) to register the task row(s). 5. Call MCP task_set_spec_path(issue_id, branch_id, spec_path) to bind the file to the row. 6. Spawn SWE with the spec_path in the prompt. ```
Replace **Validation Pipeline** so it cites MCP, not XML editing:
``` After every SWE task: 1. Re-run the spec's Verification commands yourself. 2. Read every changed file; check design compliance. 3. Spawn PR Reviewer with the spec path. PR Reviewer calls validation_record(verdict='pass'|'fail'). 4. On pass: call task_update_status(status='closed'). On fail: re-spawn SWE with feedback. Max 3 retries, then escalate. See `validate-swe-output` skill. ```
Drop **Technical Architecture Duties → BLUEPRINT.md** reference. Replace with: ``` Document architecturally significant decisions in docs/trustmybot/architecture/manual/decisions/ as numbered ADRs. Document data model + system boundaries in docs/trustmybot/architecture/manual/. The auto/ subdir is regenerated — do not hand-edit those files. (This is consumer of Phase 5 work; until then, hand-curate manual/ only.) ```
Update **Source Code Prohibition** "What you CAN write/edit" — add `docs/trustmybot/snapshots/` (architect generates snapshots via MCP tool, so the dir is implicitly architect-writable through that path — no direct edits).
Keep all other sections (Chain-of-Thought Discipline, Agent-Creator Flow, Chain of Command, Core Principles, the placeholder banner) intact.
Cite `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` once.
